item.title: AMD's Instinct MI455X: Aiming for the Sun
item.description:
📝 Instinct MI455X memory subsystem hierarchyThe inter-WGP caches have also changed to support this new design. Each XCD has 32 WGPs active, 34 physical WGPs of which 2 are fused off, which are broken up into 2 Shader Engines (SE) per XCD each with 16 WGPs. With multicast loads we can instead load this tile of A into all relevant WGPs with a single multicast load instruction.
🔗 Read more: https://chipsandcheese.com/p/amds-instinct-mi455x-aiming-for-the

item.title: Nothing works and everyone is euphoric
item.description:
📝 I keep thinking about that post every time I have to fight their product. Software vendors have long been KPI-oriented, and making things more stable doesn’t always have a direct effect on the numbers. As companies collectively spiral into AI debt, individual developers have a unique opportunity to build software that would previously have been beyond their reach.
🔗 Read more: https://ptrchm.com/posts/nothing-works-and-everyone-is-euphoric/
